fusions.name: Stoop on a Guyline
fusions.desc: Drops on an enemy up to 7 tiles away, which deals 12 damage, rising to 2 times that at maximum range, knocks it back 3 tiles and slows it by 25% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mist Net
fusions.desc: Throws a fine net in a cone 4 tiles long, which deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 35% chance to leave each [Leaden] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Ballooning
fusions.desc: Lifts you 3 tiles from where you stood, then your movement speed rises by 30% and your dodge chance by 10% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Gossamer Wake
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, a trailing thread lashes the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, which deals 5 damage and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
